title: French Kale Gratin
description: A rich and creamy side dish made with French kale, onions, and a delicious cheesy bechamel sauce. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or as a side for your holiday feast.
instructions: In a large saucepan, sauté the onions and garlic until softened.
Add the kale to the saucepan and cook until wilted.
In a separate saucepan, make a bechamel sauce by melting the butter and whisking in the flour.
Gradually add the milk, whisking constantly to prevent lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the robust cheese until melted.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of the kale mixture.
Top the kale with a layer of the bechamel sauce and then a layer of the cubed madeleine bread.
Repeat the layers two more times, finishing with a layer of the bechamel sauce.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
